evidence.title: Adversarial Machine Learning: A Taxonomy and Terminology of Attacks and Mitigations
evidence.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
evidence.claim_scope: AML taxonomy와 용어를 제공하지만 평가 표준이나 완화 효과를 보증하지 않으며 공개 errata를 함께 확인해야 합니다.
